leads.name: falahati/php-mp3
leads.description: PHP-MP3 is a simple library for reading and manipulating MPEG audio (MP3)
leads.release: v0.9.5-alpha2 (newest tag, pre-release; commit 33ffe2cb6263345aa17f296719e7261e5f351525) and dev-master commit snapshot 135aa3010cb4d3412ba442abaf2a7225bb751cf0 (not a release)
leads.family: regin / thegallagher PHP-MP3 native frame-header reader; no getID3 or Mp3Info code
leads.reason: On PHP 8.5.12 the tag never returns on either control (timeout 15 s, exit 124): since PHP 8.0, substr() past the end returns "", so getStart() does not stop. The dev-master snapshot matches the MPEG-1 control (11 frames, 44100 Hz, 64 kbit/s) but on the MPEG-2 control MpegAudio::fromFile()->getFrameCounts()/getFrameHeader(0) report 3 frames, 11025 Hz, 418-byte frames, first frame at byte 104. The oracle reads 12 frames, 22050 Hz, first frame at byte 0. The float key Version_25 = 2.5 is truncated to 2 and replaces the MPEG-2 sample-rate row, and the frame length uses the MPEG-1 144 coefficient. Only version, layer, bitrate and channel mode are correct on both controls. No public API gives a correct sample rate, frame count, frame bytes or duration on both.
